abilities.name: Deadly Demise D6
abilities.text: Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

abilities.name: Damaged 5
abilities.trigger: ¿Las heridas restantes del modelo son iguales o menores a 5?
abilities.originalText:
This ability always takes the form Damaged X. While a model’s remaining wounds are equal to or less than X, that model is damaged:
  • While a model is damaged, that model's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

abilities.name: Hover

abilities.originalText: Each time this unit takes to the skies (21.03), do not subtract 2" from the maximum distance.

abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.trigger: ¿Todos los modelos en la unidad tienen esta habilidad?
abilities.originalText: If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

abilities.name: Deep Strike

abilities.name: Terminatus Assault
abilities.originalText:
• This unit can re-roll charge rolls.
  • After this unit ends a charge move, each enemy unit engaged with this unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll if it's a non-Imperium/Chaos unit.

abilities.name: Teleport Homer
abilities.text: At the start of the battle, you can set up one Teleport Homer token for this unit on the battlefield. If you do: When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem, you can use that Teleport Homer token. If you do, that use is -1 CP, but when resolving that stratagem, this unit must be set up within 3" of that Teleport Homer token and not within 8" of an enemy unit. That Teleport Homer token is then removed from the battlefield. If an enemy unit ends a move within 1" of that Teleport Homer token, that Teleport Homer token is removed from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Scouts 6"
abilities.text: This ability always takes the form Scouts X". In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following: If that unit is in strategic reserves, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone. If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a scout move. If that unit is embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts ability, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT can make a scout move.
abilities.originalText:
This ability always takes the form Scouts X". In the Resolve Pre‑battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following:
  • If that unit is in strategic reserves, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone.
  • If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a scout move (24.32).
  • If that unit is embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts ability, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT can make a scout move.
